headline: Placeholder: Federal student loan repayment plan changes
summary: Placeholder story. A change to federal repayment plans raises monthly payments for many borrowers.

receipts.text: Your federal loan payment could rise $40–90/mo once repayment starts.
receipts.evidence: Placeholder: Borrowers on the affected plans could see payments rise by $40 to $90 a month.
